author: R. Aaij et al.
title: Test of lepton universality with $B^0 \to K^{*0} \ell^+ \ell^-$ decays
abstract: A test of lepton universality is performed by comparing the branching fractions of the decays $B^0 \to K^{*0} \mu^+ \mu^-$ and $B^0 \to K^{*0} e^+ e^-$ in the low dilepton mass squared region, $q^2 \in [0.045, 1.100]$ GeV$^2$. The ratio of these branching fractions, $R_{K^{*0}}$, is measured to be $0.66^{+0.11}_{-0.07} \pm 0.03$, consistent with the Standard Model prediction.
